observations.text: The process starts when we receive the customer's quotation request. The intended outcome is to send the quotation to the customer.
I'm the sales employee who handles the quotation process. The manager is also involved—they approve the high-value quotations. I don't know of anyone else.
After receiving the request, I check the customer information in the CRM.
After checking the customer information, I create the quotation document using the quoting system.
After I create the quotation, if the amount is over 1,000,000 yen, the manager approves it. If it's at or below 1,000,000 yen, I send it directly to the customer.
Yes, after the manager approves it, the quotation is sent to the customer.
I don't know the specific reason for checking the customer information; that's not something I have details on.
